description: Foundation: data-schema and resolution seams. Extend ShotContext with footprint fields, extend CLUB_STATS with distance bands (enforcing the R#4 band_center==distance invariant), add the seeded-RNG seam to ShotManager+WindSystem, add the R#3 footprint fast-path branch to _resolve_landing_tile, extend LieSystem with spread_mod + bag-retuned allowed_clubs, and add the new seedable content resources (HoleContext/HoleDefinition/HandDefinition). This is the groundwork every later feature builds on; each edit is surgical and leaves the build green. Independent of FEAT-002+ except as a dependency (must come first).
steps: In scripts/shot_context.gd add typed vars: aim_dir:int=0, band_min:int=0, band_max:int=0, band_center:int=0, base_spread:int=0, base_roll:int=0, spread_mod:int=0, falloff_pow:float=1.0. Extend reset() to zero the new ints, set falloff_pow=1.0, and confirm curve_strength=0.0 and curve_profile="" are cleared (they already are). Leave get_shot_distance() (aim_tile-based — R#1) and calculate_final_score()=int(round(chips*mult)) UNCHANGED.

In scripts/hex_grid.gd extend ALL 12 CLUB_STATS rows (ClubType keys) with band_min/band_max/base_spread; base_roll reuses the existing roll key. Bag-7 bands: DRIVER 22-26 center 24 R3; WOOD_3 18-20 center 19 R2; IRON_3 15-17 center 16 R1; IRON_6 12-14 center 13 R1; IRON_8 9-11 center 10 R1; PITCHING_WEDGE 5-8 center 6 R1; PUTTER 1-4 center 2 R0. Off-bag rows: WOOD_5 16-18 R2; IRON_5 14-16 R1; IRON_7 12-14 R1; IRON_9 10-12 R1; SAND_WEDGE 4-7 R1. Do NOT remove any ClubType value (IRON_7 is the fallback at ~10 CLUB_STATS.get sites).

R#4 INVARIANT: for every CLUB_STATS row set distance == band_center. Specifically set CLUB_STATS[DRIVER].distance = 24 (was 22). For every other club set .distance equal to that club's band_center (adjust band_center OR .distance so they are EQUAL for all 12 rows). Confirm no row has distance != band_center before finishing.

In scripts/shot_manager.gd add var rng: RandomNumberGenerator = null. Replace the bare randf() in BOTH _weighted_tile_selection() and _select_landing_tile_from_aoe() with (rng.randf() if rng else randf()).

In scripts/wind_system.gd change generate_wind(difficulty: float = 0.5) to generate_wind(difficulty: float = 0.5, rng: RandomNumberGenerator = null) and route its three bare calls (randf() wind_chance, randi()%8 direction, randf_range(min,max) speed) through rng when non-null, falling back to the globals when null. Leave calculate_wind_curve and get_direction_vector unchanged.

R#3: In scripts/shot_manager.gd _resolve_landing_tile(), add an EARLY branch at the top: if current_context.get_metadata("footprint_built", false) is true, set current_context.landing_tile = _weighted_tile_selection() over the existing aoe_tiles/aoe_weights, emit landing_resolved, and return — skipping _calculate_curved_target AND the aoe_system.compute_aoe rebuild. Gate on the footprint_built metadata flag ALONE (NOT aoe_weights.size()>0). Leave the legacy path intact below. Add a one-line comment: the legacy path breaks because compute_aoe(target_tile) re-keys aoe_tiles so builder weights no longer match.

In scripts/lie_system.gd add a spread_mod key to each LIE_DATA row (TEE 0, FAIRWAY 0, ROUGH +1, DEEP_ROUGH +2, SAND +2, TREE +3, GREEN 0) and have apply_lie_to_shot write context.spread_mod += lie_info.get("spread_mod", 0). Retune allowed_clubs to the bag: TEE [DRIVER,WOOD_3,IRON_3,IRON_6,IRON_8,PITCHING_WEDGE]; FAIRWAY [WOOD_3,IRON_3,IRON_6,IRON_8,PITCHING_WEDGE]; ROUGH [IRON_3,IRON_6,IRON_8,PITCHING_WEDGE]; DEEP_ROUGH/TREE [IRON_6,IRON_8,PITCHING_WEDGE]; SAND [PITCHING_WEDGE,IRON_8]; GREEN [PUTTER]; WATER/FLAG []. Keep apply_lie_to_shot writing distance_mod/roll_mod/chips/mult and allowed_clubs metadata.
Create scripts/hole_context.gd (class_name HoleContext extends RefCounted): seed:int=0, rng:RandomNumberGenerator, definition:HoleDefinition=null.

Create scripts/hole_definition.gd (class_name HoleDefinition extends Resource) with exported fields: hole_id:String, seed:int, par:int=4, use_procedural:bool=true, grid_width:int=10, grid_height:int=40, tee:Vector2i, flag:Vector2i, surface_overrides:Dictionary, elevation_overrides:Dictionary, wind_fixed:bool, wind_direction_index:int, wind_strength:int, hand_definition:HandDefinition=null.

Create scripts/cards/hand_definition.gd (class_name HandDefinition extends Resource) with exported fields: club_deck:DeckDefinition=null, modifier_deck:DeckDefinition=null, fixed_hand:bool=false, dealt_card_ids:Array[String], hand_size:int=5, seed:int=0.
Do NOT touch scripts/aoe_system.gd (calculate_weights_by_terrain left unused on the footprint path). Do NOT wire ScoringManager.
acceptance_criteria: Both clean-build commands (headless run and --editor --quit SCRIPT ERROR/parse error grep) report 0 new script errors after the feature.
Every CLUB_STATS row satisfies distance == band_center (verifiable by reading, and asserted later by the harness for DRIVER).
_resolve_landing_tile has a footprint_built-gated early branch that skips _calculate_curved_target and compute_aoe; the legacy path is unchanged.
HoleContext, HoleDefinition, HandDefinition class_names parse and register.
LIE_DATA has a spread_mod key per row and allowed_clubs retuned to the bag.

Commit the changed source files on feature/gameloop-v1 (stage specific files; do not git add -A).
findings:
FEAT-001 complete. SEAMS FOR LATER FEATS:
- ShotContext (scripts/shot_context.gd) now has: aim_dir, band_min, band_max, band_center, base_spread, base_roll, spread_mod (ints), falloff_pow (float, default 1.0). All zeroed in reset() (falloff_pow->1.0). get_shot_distance() still aim_tile-based (R#1) and calculate_final_score()=int(round(chips*mult)) unchanged.
- CLUB_STATS (hex_grid.gd, const starts line 38) each of the 12 ClubType rows now carries band_min/band_max/base_spread; base_roll should reuse existing 'roll' key. R#4 invariant holds: distance==band_center for all 12 rows. distance values now: DRIVER 24(22-26,R3), WOOD_3 19(18-20,R2), WOOD_5 17(16-18,R2), IRON_3 16(15-17,R1), IRON_5 15(14-16,R1), IRON_6 13(12-14,R1), IRON_7 13(12-14,R1), IRON_8 10(9-11,R1), IRON_9 11(10-12,R1), PITCHING_WEDGE 6(5-8,R1), SAND_WEDGE 6(4-7,R1), PUTTER 2(1-4,R0). NOTE: DRIVER.distance changed 22->24; other .distance values also shifted to match band_center — the ~10 CLUB_STATS.get(...).distance call sites now read these new centers.
- ShotManager (scripts/shot_manager.gd) has `var rng: RandomNumberGenerator = null`. Set it from the HoleContext.rng seam for deterministic landing selection. Both _weighted_tile_selection() and _select_landing_tile_from_aoe() route through (rng.randf() if rng else randf()).
- R#3 fast-path is LIVE in _resolve_landing_tile(): when current_context.get_metadata('footprint_built', false) is true it selects via _weighted_tile_selection() over the pre-built aoe_tiles/aoe_weights, emits landing_resolved, and returns WITHOUT calling _calculate_curved_target or compute_aoe. FEAT-002 TurnController must set metadata['footprint_built']=true after building aoe_tiles+aoe_weights. Reset path: ShotContext.reset() clears it via metadata.clear(). Gate is the flag ALONE (never aoe_weights.size()>0).
- WindSystem.generate_wind now takes (difficulty, rng=null); routes wind_chance/direction/speed through rng when non-null. Pass HoleContext.rng for seeded wind (R#5 crosswind-sign harness will depend on deterministic wind). calculate_wind_curve and get_direction_vector unchanged.
- LieSystem (scripts/lie_system.gd) LIE_DATA each row has a spread_mod key (TEE0 FAIRWAY0 ROUGH+1 DEEP_ROUGH+2 SAND+2 GREEN0 WATER0 TREE+3 FLAG0). apply_lie_to_shot does context.spread_mod += lie_info.get('spread_mod',0). allowed_clubs retuned to the 7-club bag per spec (TEE: DRIVER,WOOD_3,IRON_3,IRON_6,IRON_8,PITCHING_WEDGE; FAIRWAY drops DRIVER; ROUGH: IRON_3,IRON_6,IRON_8,PITCHING_WEDGE; DEEP_ROUGH/TREE: IRON_6,IRON_8,PITCHING_WEDGE; SAND: PITCHING_WEDGE,IRON_8; GREEN: PUTTER; WATER/FLAG: []).
- New content resources: scripts/hole_context.gd (HoleContext extends RefCounted: seed:int, rng:RandomNumberGenerator, definition:HoleDefinition), scripts/hole_definition.gd (HoleDefinition extends Resource, all exported fields per spec), scripts/cards/hand_definition.gd (HandDefinition extends Resource, exported fields per spec). All parse. HoleDefinition references HandDefinition; both parse at class-registration time.
- VERIFICATION: both clean-build commands reported 0 new script errors. No harness yet (FEAT-002 adds it). aoe_system.gd untouched; ScoringManager left unwired.
- COMMIT: changes committed on feature/gameloop-v1 with specific-file staging (no git add -A; asset .import churn excluded). New .gd.uid sidecars for the 3 new scripts generated by the editor import pass and staged alongside.
